title: WebSearchSettings
description:
Web-search tool endpoint settings (`tool.web_search`).

The search tool calls a keyless DuckDuckGo-compatible instant-answer endpoint, so this section carries **no credential**. It is a tool egress endpoint (not an AI provider), therefore C7 does not apply: both editions may point the tool at their own endpoint (C6 weak control). The runtime resolves **explicit settings > `ZEOKEEL_SEARCH_URL` > built-in default** and requires https. `schemars` bounds the timeout so the generated Ajv schema rejects out-of-range values before Rust validation runs (C10).

base_url.description: Endpoint base URL (https only); empty = fall back to the env/default.
